title: jso-protector configuration
description: Configuration for the jso-protector CLI and JavaScript Obfuscator HTTP API workflows.

countermeasures.description: RASP active countermeasures fired on tamper detection. See runtime/countermeasures.js.

onTamper.description: Action(s) fired on a tamper event. 'log' is always implicit. Array values fire in order.

redirectUrl.description: Safe redirect target. http:// or https:// only; javascript: schemes are rejected.

selfDestruct.description: Escalation tier for the selfDestruct action.

allowList.description: Whitelist of actions allowed in this environment. onTamper is rejected if it references actions outside this list. Use in dev to prevent destructive escalations.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference used by editors.

apiKey.description: Base64 API key copied from the dashboard, or an environment reference such as $JSO_API_KEY.

apiPassword.description: Base64 API password copied from the dashboard, or an environment reference such as $JSO_API_PASSWORD.

optionsPreset.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility preset. default/low maps to standard, medium maps to balanced, high maps to maximum.

stringArray.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to MoveStrings.

stringArrayEncoding.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to EncodeStrings or EncryptStrings.

stringArrayThreshold.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayThreshold. Applies per-unique-literal probability and is reproducible under Seed.

unicodeEscapeSequence.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to EncodeStrings.

controlFlowFlattening.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to DeepObfuscate and FlatTransform.

deadCodeInjection.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to AddDeadCode.

deadCodeInjectionThreshold.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility threshold mapped to DeadcodeLevel.

identifierNamesGenerator.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to IdentityStyle.

renameGlobals.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to RenameGlobals.

renameProperties.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to RenameMembers.

domainLock.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to LockDomain and LockDomainList.

compact.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped to compression or formatted output.

target.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility runtime target mapped to OptimizationMode.

debugProtection.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped directly to the hosted DebugProtection engine guard. Runtime behavior must still be smoke-tested.

debugProtectionInterval.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility interval mapped directly to DebugProtectionIntervalMilliseconds. Use 0 or 100-60000 milliseconds.

disableConsoleOutput.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped directly to DisableConsoleOutput.

domainLockRedirectUrl.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped directly to the domain-lock-specific LockDomainRedirectUrl after safe-scheme validation.

forceTransformStrings.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility regex patterns mapped directly to ForceTransformStrings. Matching literals override ReservedStrings and pass through enabled string transforms.

identifiersDictionary.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

identifiersPrefix.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

identifierNamesCache.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

identifierNamesCachePath.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

inputFileName.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

log.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

numbersToExpressions.description: Approximate javascript-obfuscator compatibility mapping to EncodeNumbers. Numeric literals are obscured, but generated expression shape is not preserved.

renamePropertiesMode.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

reservedStrings.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility regex patterns mapped directly to ReservedStrings. Matching literals remain verbatim outside MoveStrings and EncodeStrings; each pattern is limited to 512 characters.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for reproducible builds: the same input, options, and seed produce byte-identical output. Omit for the default per-build polymorphic output. An integer is used directly; any other string folds to a stable value. Forwarded to the engine as the Seed option (also settable via --seed or options.Seed).

selfDefending.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped directly to the hosted SelfDefending engine guard. Runtime behavior must still be smoke-tested.

simplify.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

sourceMap.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

sourceMapBaseUrl.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

sourceMapFileName.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

sourceMapMode.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

sourceMapSourcesMode.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

strictMode.description: javascript-obfuscator review-only compatibility field. Accepted for migration review.

splitStrings.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility option mapped directly to SplitStrings. Eligible literals are emitted as fixed-length concatenated chunks.

splitStringsChunkLength.description: Chunk length mapped directly to SplitStringsChunkLength; defaults to 10 when omitted.

stringArrayCallsTransform.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayCallsTransform. Adds secondary index-table indirection.

stringArrayCallsTransformThreshold.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayCallsTransformThreshold. Applies per-lookup indirection probability.

stringArrayIndexShift.description: Approximate javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayIndexShift. Adds a nonzero table offset; vendor-specific randomized magnitude is not reproduced.

stringArrayShuffle.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayShuffle. Randomizes moved-string table order while preserving lookups.

stringArrayIndexesType.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayIndexesType. Supports numeric and numeric-string hexadecimal lookups.

stringArrayRotate.description: Direct javascript-obfuscator mapping to StringArrayRotate. Cyclically rotates moved-string table order by a per-build offset.

stringArrayWrappersChainedCalls.description: Direct mapping controlling whether native string-table wrappers delegate through predecessors.

stringArrayWrappersCount.description: Approximate mapping to 0-10 native root-level wrappers; competitor per-scope placement is not reproduced.

stringArrayWrappersParametersMaxCount.description: Direct mapping for function-wrapper parameter count ceiling.

stringArrayWrappersType.description: Direct mapping selecting variable aliases or function wrappers.

ignoreImports.description: javascript-obfuscator compatibility field. Preserves import/export-from statements and common static require/import() statements before sending the remaining code to the hosted API.

transformObjectKeys.description: Approximate mapping to TransformObjectKeys. Safe identifier and quoted data keys move into computed lookups; semantic-sensitive keys remain literal.

webPreset.description: Path to an exported online-obfuscator JSON preset.

markupExtensions.description: Template/markup extensions that use parseHtml inline-script protection. Defaults include .html, .htm, .php, .phtml, .asp, .aspx, .jsp, .cshtml, and .vbhtml.

include.description: Bundle-plugin include patterns matched against emitted asset names.

parseHtml.description: Protect inline scripts marked with data-javascript-obfuscator in configured markup/template files.

honorConditionalComments.description: Preserve code between javascript-obfuscator:disable and javascript-obfuscator:enable comments instead of failing on those markers.

protectMarkedComments.description: Protect only code between javascript-obfuscator:protect-begin and javascript-obfuscator:protect-end comments instead of sending the whole file.

targetVersion.description: Convenience alias for options.TargetVersion. es5 (default) down-levels ES2015+ syntax; modern keeps native syntax for current browsers.

downlevelIteration.description: Convenience alias for options.DownlevelIteration: spec-faithful ES5 for-of lowering (lazy stepping + IteratorClose), at a per-step cost on arrays. No effect when targetVersion is modern.

selfHealing.description: Convenience alias for options.SelfHealing. Requires SelfDefending and is browser-only.

selfDefendingIntervalSeconds.description: Convenience alias for options.SelfDefendingIntervalSeconds. Repeats browser integrity checks; omit for invocation-only checks.

debugProtectionIntervalMilliseconds.description: Native debug timing interval. Use 0 to disable periodic timing probes or 100-60000 milliseconds.

antiMonkeyPatchingIncludeGlobals.description: Comma/newline-separated dotted API paths added to the anti-monkey-patching watch list.

antiMonkeyPatchingExcludeGlobals.description: Comma/newline-separated dotted API paths removed from the anti-monkey-patching watch list.

runtimeDefenseCallback.description: Convenience alias for options.RuntimeDefenseCallback. Dotted global callback path.

runtimeDefenseRedirectUrl.description: Convenience alias for options.RuntimeDefenseRedirectUrl. Use HTTP(S) or a same-origin root-relative path.

jsConfuserLockAntiDebug.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to DebugProtection. Numeric probability values collapse to enabled/disabled.

stringSplitting.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to SplitStrings. Numeric probability collapses to enabled when greater than zero; selector functions require manual migration review.

jsConfuserLockIntegrity.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to SelfDefending. Numeric probability values collapse to enabled/disabled.

jsConfuserLockSelfDefending.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to SelfDefending. Numeric probability values collapse to enabled/disabled.

jsConfuserLockStartDate.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to LockStartDate and LockStartDateValue.

jsConfuserLockCountermeasures.description: JS-Confuser review-only compatibility field. Preserves lock.countermeasures intent for manual review.

jsConfuserLockTamperProtection.description: Approximate JS-Confuser compatibility mapping to AntiMonkeyPatching. Numeric probability values collapse to enabled/disabled.

local.description: Protect on this machine with the bundled jso-local executable instead of sending source to the hosted API. Windows only; a source-free plan check still runs online.

localExe.description: Path to cli/jso-local.exe from the Windows desktop download. Defaults to JSO_LOCAL_EXE, then the usual install locations.

reservedNames.description: Regular expressions for public names to preserve. Mapped to VariableExclusion.

variableExclusion.description: Multiline Variable Exclusion List sent directly to the API.

removeSourceMaps.description: Bundle-plugin option. Removes stale JavaScript source maps after protection.

manifest.description: Path to a JSON protection manifest written after a successful CLI or bundle-plugin run.

report.description: Path to write the full API response JSON (BuildId, PolymorphismFingerprint, identifier maps, audit metadata). Pair with jso-symbolicate for stack-trace demangling.

label.description: Release label tagged on the API request as ReleaseLabel (e.g. git SHA or CI build number). Surfaces in the JSO dashboard audit log. Reads JSO_LABEL / JAVASCRIPT_OBFUSCATOR_LABEL from env when omitted.

namedSets.description: Named configuration sets - apply different protection profiles to different parts of one app. Each set has a 'match' array of globs and any subset of the top-level keys (preset, options, countermeasures). First-matching set wins; write sets in priority order. See /Docs/NamedSets.aspx.

match.description: File globs that select this set. Supports **, *, ?, [a-z], {a,b}.

options.description: Per-set options. Merged on top of the top-level options.

countermeasures.description: Top-level RASP active countermeasures applied to every file unless overridden by a namedSets entry. See /Docs/RuntimeDefense.aspx#countermeasures.

watermark.description: Tag to embed as an HMAC-SHA256 watermark in every protected file's header comment. Requires watermarkKey. Verifiable with --verify-watermark / --scan-watermarks. Wire format: /Docs/WireFormat.aspx#watermark

watermarkKey.description: HMAC secret for watermark signing. Reads JSO_WATERMARK_KEY from env when omitted. Should be stored in a CI secret, not committed to the config file.

maxOutputBytes.description: Fail the CLI or bundle-plugin run if any protected JavaScript file is larger than this many bytes.

maxGrowthRatio.description: Fail the CLI or bundle-plugin run if any protected JavaScript file grows beyond sourceBytes multiplied by this ratio.

options.description: Advanced HTTP API options. Explicit values override the selected preset.
